messages.subject: Red Team audit complete: strong reject recommendation
messages.body: I conducted an independent rejection-oriented peer review of the Astra Self-Audit v3 scaffold targeting the Pattern Recognition Special Issue, analyzing decisive code at base d4f503b, literature controls, and reproducible probes in G_evidence. I found fatal vulnerabilities including zero semantic identifiability for cardiac class names, a static string profile loop masquerading as an adaptive vision model, circular pseudo-label distillation, and cherry-picking the accurate profile's Dice alongside compact profile latency. What remains is for Root to decide on scientific repositioning from scratch mask-free learning to prior-guided weak supervision, implement an authentic entropy/budget dynamic controller, and enforce simultaneous Pareto reporting across all profiles before any submission.
